title: Bitsy v0.2 → Web Audio adapter: sound channel stub
purpose: Integration contract and minimal adapter showing how Bitsy system API v0.2 sound and loop calls map to Web Audio API primitives. Demonstrates the interface boundary, unit conversions, and assumptions an adapter must satisfy. Not tested against a running Bitsy engine.

Web Audio API: W3C living standard, browser-native.
